svg.aria-label: Simulated thermogravimetric data, seed 720, with an initial mass of 10 mg. All percentages use that initial mass. The blank follows the same temperature and atmosphere program, and the DTG sign convention makes mass loss positive. Cubic local-polynomial windows contain 7, 21 or 61 points; at 0.05 min sampling intervals, they span 0.3, 1.0 or 3.0 min.
